desc: Kit includes: Lock-N-Load Classic single-stage press, Lock-N-Load Powder Measure, Magnetic Scale, The Hornady Handbook of Cartridge Reloading (two volume set), Three Lock-N-Load Die Bushings, Primer Catcher, Positive Priming System, Automatic Primer Feed, Universal Reloading Block, Chamfering and Deburring Tool, Primer Turning Plate, and One Shot Case Lube.
